message:
We all know that one friend who tends to panic at the slightest hint of a storm or a sudden change in plans. 😅 While it can be easy to roll our eyes, there's something to be said for being prepared, even if it feels a bit over the top sometimes. This resource helps us think through what we might need in our cars for unexpected situations—whether it's a flat tire or getting caught in bad weather. 

Taking a little time to plan ahead can make a big difference in how we feel when surprises come our way. How do you stay prepared on the go?
